type.stills.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.stills.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.stills.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.stills.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.stills.cfg.slice_mode.help: Video is published band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the full frame (sub-frame latency). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. Disabled (default) = historical behaviour.
type.stills.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.stills.label: Stills
plugin.stills.fade_tip: Cross-fade duration when the image changes (0 = straight cut). Repositioning the image stays a cut.
plugin.stills.lib_hint: Double-click or “Show”: the image goes on air. Drag an image onto a bin to put it there.
plugin.stills.take_direct_tip: Checked: picking an image puts it straight on air (no preview)
plugin.stills.view_key_tip: Show the key (alpha) instead of the fill over a checkerboard
plugin.stills.stream_tip: Opens the output as a WebRTC stream in the monitor: to see a fade for real
plugin.stills.lib_hint2: Double-click or "Pick": the image goes to PREVIEW (TAKE sends it on air; in "Direct take" mode it goes on air at once). Drag an image onto a bin to file it there.
type.stills.cfg.take_direct.label: Direct take
type.stills.cfg.take_direct.help: Unchecked (default): picking an image puts it in PREVIEW and the Take button sends it on air (with the configured fade). Checked: picking an image puts it straight on air.
type.stills.cfg.transition_ms.label: Cross-fade between two images (ms)
type.stills.cfg.transition_ms.help: Length of the cross-fade when the image changes (fill AND key). 0 = hard cut. It only applies to an image CHANGE: repositioning the image stays a cut. Overridable per change (the “Fade” parameter of the “Show an image” action) and hot (the “Default fade length” action).
plugin.stills.resize_tip: Drag to resize the PREVIEW / PROGRAM screens (double-click: default size)
plugin.stills.pgm_right_tip: Only the PROGRAM screen, on the right: the library takes the full height on the left. The preview stays active (its name is shown) and TAKE sends it on air.
plugin.stills.side_resize_tip: Drag to widen or narrow the PROGRAM column (double-click: default width)
